messages:
sasha: Dense fog advisory this morning visibility downtown is like 50 ft, Muni is crawling and the ferry voiceover sounded like a ghost ship. Anyone switching to WFH? :cloud: :fog:
noah: Outbound ferry delayed "approximately 30 min" per the tannoy. If anyone needs to get to Burlingame, might be better to drive or push to Caltrain.
emily: Office plants are getting jealous of my WFH sunlamp. I'll tag :house: for the poll. Also, the 2nd-floor bike rack is fine but use lights if you're heading out.
kai: For folks at Embarcadero: I can pick up one person and drop near Montgomery at 8:30. Car's tiny but dry. DM me. :car:
sasha: Thanks kai! Also there's a tiny left-luggage pile in the lobby a pair of gloves + a knit hat. If you lost them holler.
ops-bot: SFMTA alert: Route 14 and 30 experiencing 15-20 min delays due to low visibility on Market St. https://status.sfmta.com/incidents/6789
tara: PSA: capoeira meetup postponed because the fog made the plaza slippery. We'll reschedule. :pray:
noah: Photo posted (fog over ferry terminal) not graphic, just moody. If you're commuting, expect longer waits and consider bringing a thermos.
emily: Tiny logistics note coffee machine upstairs is out until maintenance finishes. There's a stash of K-Cups in the pantry if you need a fix.
sasha: Poll: :house: = WFH, :office: = coming in (react within 10). I'll compile for ops re: desk occupancy.
kai: Also, if anyone's stranded near 4th & King and needs a last-mile lift, I'm circling that area in ~25.
ops-bot: Weather alert updated: Dense fog advisory until 10:00 AM. Travel slowly, watch for cyclists.
tara: If you're coming in, bring a spare pair of socks. My shoes were glorified sponges this morning. :sweat_smile:
noah: Quick tip: if you use the Muni app, the predicted arrivals are more helpful than the boards today. Saved me 12 minutes.
emily: WFH gang, feel free to ping me if you want a virtual coffee break at 10. I'll bring oatmeal.
sasha: Heading out in 5 to brave the mist. Stay visible, friends. :headlight:
